description: Send a quote request to the FickelUSA team for apparel, headwear, or a screen-printed product (artwork review) or for a custom or large order. Minimum order is 100 pieces. This only creates a pending request: no order is placed, no payment is taken and nothing ships. Returns a reference number; FickelUSA follows up by email. For most products that are not apparel, headwear, or screen printed, use buy_now instead and have the buyer complete the purchase on the fickelusa.com page.

contact_name.description: Full name of the person requesting the quote.

email.description: Email address where FickelUSA should send the quote.

imprint_notes.description: Optional logo or imprint notes, e.g. "1-color logo on left chest".

needed_by.description: Optional date the items are needed, YYYY-MM-DD.

notes.description: Optional notes, e.g. sizes or colors. Links are removed.

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote from FickelUSA
